units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 21:33">Targ. O. Ex. XXI, 33</cite> <he>יִכְרֵי</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>יִכְרֶה</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 40:7">Targ. Ps. XL, 7</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 51a:16">B. Kam. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>אמרי ליה זיל כְּרֵי לן ואזל כְּרָא להו</he> (some ed. <cite ref="K01095"><he>כָּרָה</he></cite> hebr.) they said to him, go and dig for us, and he went and dug &c.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 48a:12">Ib. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>כמאן דכַרְיֵיה דמי</he> he is as responsible as if he had dug it.

Succ. 53ᵇ בְּרִינָן פורתא וכ׳ we bore only a little and there comes water; a. e.—*Taan. 24ᵃ דהוה כָּרֵיא בהוצא that he was boring a hole in the fence (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note for Var. lect.).—[כרי to be narrow, distressed, part. כְּרִי, כַּרְיָא, pl. כְּרִין, v. כְּרַהּ]
